name: Shiranui Mai
source:
Job: In the day an OL, At night a phantom thief
Birthplace: Japan
Hobby: Cooking (Making Bento)
Important Thing: A Kanzashi that she got from her grandmother
Likes: Zouni soup, Ohagi riceballs
